changes: Patina Plot is now Vellum Plot: a new name, a teal icon and a new home at vellumplot.github.io. Projects are .vlmp files; .ptn projects still open, and your settings and templates come along.

The Assistant (Ctrl+L): ask in plain words and it plots, fits and styles graphs, through Claude Code or Codex on your own plan, or your own API key for Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini or a compatible service.
Fonts for axes and colour bars: choose the font of tick labels and titles, not only its size.
Donate: a button at the top right of the ribbon opens the author's Ko-fi page; its x hides it for good.
The MCP server is now vellum-plot-mcp.exe: AI clients set up with patina-mcp.exe need the new path, shown on the Start page.
